So around the time when I was 15/16 me and my friends at school use to smoke a ton of pot, I always had fairly odd reactions to it compared to everyone else but it was always fun towards the end of the summer holidays my friends tried a research chemical (you might call them "legal highs") called "Atomic bomb" the two that tried it had pretty crazy experiences so one night at a friends house I decided I would try it. We headed outside and lit it up in a pipe I took 4 deep hits then we went into his garage to play some pool I pick up the cue and look at the table, this is when I realised something was wrong I collapsed sideways. This is where my memory of what I did goes, the memory I have of the next half an hour is just what happened in my own head. In their words I started screaming and throwing the pool balls everywhere over the next half hour I didn't stop crying/yelling/screaming and trying to throw the occasional punch.

What follows in my memory of that half an hour is what can only be described as the worst fucking trip ever. I felt like I was stuck inside my own mind for what felt like 6+ months I'm not sure your perception of time is super warped while you're tripping like this but what happened in that time is what I can only imagine hell to be like the same scenes playing over and over in my head one of them that I remember vividly being dragged backwords down a street by what I believe was a policeman while the words stop/no/you can't/dont do this repeated over and over and over again all this time the pain is unbelievable. I'm not sure how to explain this to people who haven't been through similar experiences but I can only express it as imagine having a hot needle rammed through all of the nerves in your body and that barely expresses it, the world around me had ceased to exist I had no thoughts just the experiences that were happening at the time. The repeating images and pain.

I think what really messed me up the most was how it all ended, as the trip wore off I started to become more lucid for periods of time so to begin with I would be okay for 1 second then I would go back in for a period of time then I would be okay for 2 seconds then go back in for a period of time so each time I would build up some hope then it would get crushed like some fucking cosmic joke by the time it finally ended I was at about 30 seconds of lucidness then back into hell. When it ended I was still fucking terrified that it was just going to happen again that it was just letting it build up again to crush my hope even more.

So that's pretty much the explanation of that night it's not the easiest to explain as I don't really have anything to reference most of the experiences of my trip with. From that day on I started having massive panic attacks on a daily basis whenever something repeated 3/4 times I would have a panic attack I still can't handle repetition at all 4 years down the line. One of the most ridiculous things is that one of my triggers is being asked if I'm okay, so if I start panicking and people ask me if I'm okay it makes it 10 times worse, this is because during my trip my friends were constantly asking me if I was okay and I guess this penetrated somehow.

I started having hallucinations, nothing extreme distorted vision shadows that weren't there I have auditory hallucinations whenever it's silent, panicked voices that are undecipherable. Obviously me running out of class everyday got noticed so I had to explain to my parents what happened they were good about it but obviously didn't understand the extent of what had happened, no one did and no one does most people don't even have a frame of reference for what I went through I'm sure other people who have had similar experiences if they exist will be able to relate. So I got sent to a psychologist, they were no help at all trying to find out what was the underlying meaning to my problems. Get fucked I know what they mean and where they come from.

So yeah that stupid mistake of that night haunts me to this day and I know I will never be able to get passed it and will never be able to receive help from anyone about my problems.
